briefing.en: Your project was due yesterday. Your manager Snehal is waiting for your update. Talk to the team, find out what is really going on, and agree what happens next.

content.en: Client hard cutoff is in 3 days (Friday). Snehal has been holding them off.

unlock_question.en: Is there any flexibility, and what happens if it slips?

content.en: Vansh built a reusable module covering about half the remaining work and can pair for an afternoon.

unlock_question.en: What is left and can you help / pair?

content.en: Team norm: a same-day heads-up on a delay is expected and is not counted against review.

unlock_question.en: What should I have done when I first knew?

goals.label: Own the delay and report status honestly to Snehal
Clarify the remaining requirements with Vansh
Agree a date with Snehal and recap it

npcs.name: Snehal Mane
npcs.persona: Direct and fair project manager. Cares about clear commitments and concrete next steps, not excuses.
npcs.public_context: Snehal Mane manages the project and is waiting on Shubhankar Parsewar's overdue update.

npcs.name: Vansh Singh
npcs.persona: Helpful senior teammate. Knows the codebase well and will pitch in when asked directly.
npcs.public_context: Vansh Singh is a teammate who knows the codebase and can explain what is left.

npcs.name: Prathamest Surwase
npcs.persona: Supportive peer. Good person to ask for candid advice on handling the situation.
npcs.public_context: Prathamest Surwase is a peer on the team who gives straight advice.
